title: Add underline for text
author: wireframe-dev
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem?

I use Excalidraw for UI wireframes and I need to show links and emphasis. There is bold-looking font weight via fonts, but no way to underline text.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Add an "Underline" toggle to the text properties panel, and Ctrl+U as a shortcut. Underline should apply to the whole text element, like other text styles.

### Additional context

Underline should follow the text color and work for text inside shapes and for arrow labels.

---
